latest_commit.message: worker-c: Keep BTC and ETH distinct in same-source revision selection

validation.qualification: Executor done record matches SHA and task requires targeted and full pytest; no planner-side pytest was run.

planner_statuses.A: automation/planner_status/A-20261009-8010dfa-kote-continue-1400.json: CONTINUE exact HEAD; later Kote runonce tasks failed Gemini invalid JSON

quality_audit.point_in_time: FlowObservation.visible_at excludes unknown available_at and values after as_of; point_in_time_filter must precede revision selection; existing regression tests cover delayed correction.
quality_audit.clocks: FlowObservation separately records effective_at_ms, available_at_ms and observed_at_ms; enforces available<=observed. Revision winner ranks available, observed, revision.
quality_audit.revision: Fixed numeric r9/r10 ordering and r1/r01 raw-label ties; remaining same-key same-revision same-available/observed conflict is input-order dependent.
quality_audit.asset_identity: revision_key now includes uppercased asset; economic_event dedup groups by asset. BTC/ETH tests cover permutations.
quality_audit.economic_event_dedup: Explicit economic_event_id required; cross-provider ties use quality, attribution, observed, source, source_record_id, revision, observation_id.
quality_audit.provenance: source_record_id and revision are retained, but conflicting same-record values with equal rank select first input without conflict flag, causing unstable value and provenance.
quality_audit.context_only: handoff separates context-only and scoring rows; evidence_health scoring freshness excludes context-only; no scoring formula change requested.
quality_audit.missingness: Unknown availability excluded; evidence_health reports missing/scoring_missing and null ages; no zero-filling of unavailable freshness.
quality_audit.tests: test_contracts_normalization.py covers PIT correction, revision aliases, cross-asset identity and duplicate ties but no identical-clock+revision conflicting-value permutation.

defect.reproducer: Construct a=FlowObservation(family='etf',metric='net_flow_usd',asset='BTC',unit='USD',source='src',source_record_id='rec',revision='1',effective_at_ms=1000,available_at_ms=1000,observed_at_ms=1000,value=100); b identical except value=200. select_latest_revisions([a,b])[0].value == 100, but select_latest_revisions([b,a])[0].value == 200. Same effect through normalize_and_dedup; no economic_event_id needed. This is deterministic on exact HEAD selection rank logic.
defect.impact: Input ordering silently determines selected conflicting economic value and source provenance. No explicit conflict flag or deterministic policy.

next: If pending remains empty and repository safety permits, enqueue one narrow Gemini task to deterministic-handle equal-rank conflicting values with permutation tests and full Capital Flow pytest; never modify Specialist code directly.
